findings.title: Service selects no pods
findings.cause: Ingress web sends traffic to Service web, which has no pods because Deployment web is scaled to 0 replicas

evidence.command: kubectl get deployment web -n kd-ingress-scaled-to-zero -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}'

evidence.what: Ingress web routes to Service web
evidence.command: kubectl get ingress web -n kd-ingress-scaled-to-zero -o jsonpath='{.spec}'

findings.fix: Scale Deployment web up (kubectl scale --replicas), or check what scaled it down (an HPA, KEDA or a deploy pipeline); if it is retired, remove the Ingress route.
